title: Book The Blue Bee | Rosemary Beach Vacation House Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

A Loft in the Sky, Steps from Everything

Searching for a luxurious beach experience? Welcome to The Blue Bee. A light-filled, loft-style retreat, perched high above the center of Rosemary Beach. The Blue Bee is the quintessential escape you’ve been dreaming of. Think crisp white interiors swirled with watercolor blues and beautifully curated moments. One of Rosemary Beach’s newest, upscale properties, The Blue Bee is both serene, and luxurious, perfect for couples, a chic girl’s getaway, or memory making family vacations. The Blue Bee is where you come to exhale.

The Location

Set along Florida’s Scenic 30A (famous for its sugar-white sand and turquoise water), Rosemary Beach feels like a European village by the sea, with no passport required. Its stunning architecture inspired by the Dutch West Indies and the Mediterranean, will leave you speechless. The Blue Bee’s unmatched convenience to the glittering gulf, incredible dining and upscale shops, all make this spectacular property a perfect choice for your 30a getaway. Every element of a dreamy trip is within your reach.

The Space

Living & Dining

Unwind in The Blue Bee’s coastal living room. An airy open floor plan featuring white oak hardwood floors, custom Serena & Lily furnishings, a built-in fireplace, and dining for six. Perfect for cozy nights in, quality time spent together or elegant pre-dinner drinks.

Coastal Chef’s Kitchen

Find everything you might need in The Blue Bee's coastal chef’s kitchen. Iridescent accents evoke the feeling of being inside a seashell. An open interactive space makes cooking and entertaining a pleasure filled experience. Fully stocked for whipping up a gourmet meal, or just enjoying takeout at the spacious breakfast bar, you’ll find a new Bosch dishwasher, stainless steel appliances, and the pièce de résistance: pale-blue SMEG accents that make morning coffee and smoothie making playful and fun.

Bedrooms

Primary King Suite: Relax in a private and luxurious king suite complete with four-poster bed, double-height ceilings, Juliette balcony, and sumptuous primary en-suite bathroom. A custom makeup vanity makes getting ready for dinners out a pleasure.

Guest Room: Enjoy a serene retreat with views that overlook Barrett Square. An adjacent full bath with custom whimsical wallpaper and tub perfect for a soak or bathing little ones before bed.

Bunk Room: Custom twin XL bunk beds with built-in TVs for each await. Ideal for little ones, but also comfortable and cozy for adults when needed.

Loft Office

Climb the spiral-staircase to a quiet loft/office space with views of the Gulf in the distance. Savor the scenery while being productive or curl up with a book and enjoy The Blue Bee from above.

Outdoor Living

Step onto The Blue Bee’s spacious private patio for coffee, cocktails, and morning breezes. Linger over board games, books, and post-beach sunsets. Unwind in a space where time moves slower and conversations feel more meaningful.

Amenities

Amenities also include brand new washer and dryer in the apartment, 4 private pools within the Rosemary Beach community, private beach access via 9 beach walkovers, world class tennis facilities, a fitness center, your own parking space and prime proximity to Scenic 30A. Each picturesque and unique neighborhood is just a short drive or within walking distance. Ideal for quiet, refined stays where your memories will last long after you checkout.

*Please, absolutely no pets and no smoking*

BOOK YOUR STAY

Your next Rosemary Beach® moment is one click away.

Check availability, browse pricing, and reserve effortlessly through RosemaryBeach.com.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
